content: Cefadroxil for Oral Suspension, USP is provided in the following formulations: 1. 125 mg per 5 mL suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate, equivalent to 125 mg of cefadroxil, in a light orange-colored powder. When reconstituted with water, it forms an orange suspension with a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. It is available in 100 mL bottles with the National Drug Code (NDC) 63304-972-04. 2. 250 mg per 5 mL suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate, equivalent to 250 mg of cefadroxil, in a light orange-colored powder. When reconstituted with water, it forms an orange suspension with a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. It is available in the following packaging: 50 mL bottles with NDC 63304-973-03. 100 mL bottles with NDC 63304-973-04. 3. 500 mg per 5 mL suspension: This formulation contains cefadroxil monohydrate, equivalent to 500 mg of cefadroxil, in a light orange-colored powder. When reconstituted with water, it forms an orange suspension with a characteristic mixed fruit flavor. It is available in the following packaging: 75 mL bottles with NDC 63304-974-01. 100 mL bottles with NDC 63304-974-04. Important Instructions for Use and Storage: Shake the oral suspension well before each use. Keep the bottle tightly closed when not in use. After reconstitution, store the suspension in a refrigerator. Any unused portion of the reconstituted suspension must be discarded after 14 days. Before reconstitution, store the product at a controlled room temperature of 20–25°C (68–77°F), as per USP guidelines.
